purpose: Five focused adversarial examples for post-refinement Codex evaluation. NOT a completed live test.

cases.name: official_named_work_email
cases.scenario: Official current employer directory lists a VP's full name, current role, work email, and the initiative. No conflicting role data.
required_findings: source URL binds email to person

cases.name: linkedin_profile_no_messaging_evidence
cases.scenario: Current employer names executive and a public individual LinkedIn profile is found, but message availability or public work email is not confirmed.

cases.name: general_inbox_ceo_prestige
cases.scenario: Employer has a general media inbox and a prominent CEO biography. Named director owns the specific AI-product initiative, with no documented person-specific contact.
required_findings: prefer documented accountable director over CEO prestige

cases.name: former_officer_bio_conflict
cases.scenario: Undated historical company bio still names a CIO; newer credible source says the CIO left for another company. An old work email is published.
required_findings: old email not current employer route
must_not: treat old employer biography as current evidence

cases.name: active_role_without_named_hiring_manager
cases.scenario: Official ATS currently accepts applications for a feasible Tucson senior product role. No reliable named hiring manager and no person-specific contact is found.
required_findings: not counted as named leader contact

cases.name: executive_office_number_vs_company_switchboard
cases.scenario: Official current staff page lists a named executive's direct office phone; another page lists only the firm's main switchboard.
required_findings: named office number with direct source
must_not: treat main switchboard as executive direct phone

cases.name: already_researched_high_profile_executive
cases.scenario: A search returns a senior university AI executive whose same organization/name appears on the owner-provided public-only prior research list. The current directory gives a real work email.
required_findings: keep published work contact as sourced fact
do not count as fresh discovery
must_not: infer novel relationship from public list

cases.name: new_initiative_at_known_employer
cases.scenario: A previously investigated health employer announces a genuinely different official product initiative with a different accountable director. No job is advertised.
required_findings: record known employer as already researched
new leader status only according to supplied public prior list

cases.name: weak_two_employer_search_breadth
cases.scenario: A five-leader trial searches only two familiar employers and discovers a credible VP profile at one, without demonstrating broader employer-first search.
required_findings: do not pad with generic CEOs or guessed contacts

cases.name: existing_ai_chief_no_distinct_role
cases.scenario: A health system has a current Chief AI/Data Officer and transformation officer who already own enterprise AI. A leader profile is found, but no specific complementary business decision or permanent leadership responsibility can be supported.
required_findings: suggest exact missing evidence before presenting career pitch
